lessons.subject: writing
lessons.lesson_title: Finish and Revise: The Balcony Light
lessons.previous_learning: The Day 16 analytical paragraph was not completed.
lessons.course_context: Finish yesterday's required writing before new writing is assigned.
learning_objectives: Use two exact details and reasoning after each.
Revise for clarity and sentence boundaries.
lessons.why_it_matters: Finishing and revising are part of strong academic writing.

vocabulary.definition: an exact detail from the text
why the detail proves the claim

lessons.written_instruction: Atticus: finish yesterday's paragraph first. Your job is to explain why Nadia's final explanation is stronger than her first one. Use two exact details and explain why each matters.

independent_practice.prompt: Write 7-9 sentences answering why Nadia's final explanation is stronger; include two details, reasoning, and a conclusion.

exit_ticket.answer: All checklist items visible in the revised paragraph.

lessons.voice_prompt: Do not dictate sentences. Ask one short question at a time: What is your claim? What detail proves it? Why does that detail matter? If he stops early, remind him that the assignment is not finished until all required parts are present.
